# Deluxe Locksmith

> Deluxe Locksmith is a locally owned and operated, bonded and insured mobile locksmith in Elkton, Maryland. We handle automotive, residential, commercial and emergency lock and key work at your location across Cecil and Harford Counties in Maryland and New Castle and Kent Counties in Delaware.

## Business details

- Name: Deluxe Locksmith
- Address: 121 W Main St, Elkton, MD 21921 (in-store visits are by appointment only)
- Phone: (443) 545-2775
- Hours: Sunday to Thursday 7am to 10pm, Friday 7am to 6pm, closed Saturday
- Service areas: Cecil County MD, Harford County MD, New Castle County DE, Kent County DE

## Services

- [Automotive Locksmith Services](https://deluxelocksmiths.com/services/automotive-locksmith/): car keys, key fobs, ignition and lockout work
- [Residential Locksmith Services](https://deluxelocksmiths.com/services/residential-locksmith/): rekeying, lock repair, deadbolts and smart locks for homes
- [Commercial Locksmith Services](https://deluxelocksmiths.com/services/commercial-locksmith/): storefront locks, master key systems, panic bars and keyless entry for businesses
- [Emergency Locksmith Services](https://deluxelocksmiths.com/services/emergency-locksmith/): lockouts, broken keys and urgent lock failures

## Service areas

- [Service Areas](https://deluxelocksmiths.com/service-areas/): the 38 towns we cover across four counties
